Estamos em busca de um Product Owner altamente motivado e focado em resultados para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras de crédito com garantias. O candidato ideal será responsável por definir e priorizar o backlog de produtos, trabalhar diretamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e garantir que nossas soluções atendam às necessidades dos clientes e do negócio. Além disso, terá um papel fundamental na validação de hipóteses, utilizando testes e experimentos para tomar decisões baseadas em dados e aprimorar continuamente o produto.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo que as funcionalidades entreguem valor ao cliente e ao negócio.
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas internas (executivos, marketing, vendas, suporte ao cliente) para alinhamento da visão do produto e definição de prioridades.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir testes e experimentos para validar hipóteses de funcionalidades, utilizando abordagens como testes A/B, MVPs (Produto Mínimo Viável) e outras técnicas de validação.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio e de usuários em histórias claras e detalhadas para o time de desenvolvimento, com critérios de aceitação bem definidos.
  • Monitorar e analisar os resultados de testes para determinar o sucesso das hipóteses e ajustar o backlog com base em dados concretos e insights obtidos.
  • Gerenciar o roadmap do produto, garantindo que as entregas estejam alinhadas às necessidades estratégicas da empresa e do mercado.
  • Trabalhar com a metodologia ágil (Scrum/Kanban), liderando cerimônias como refinamento de backlog, sprint planning e revisões de sprint.
  • Validar as entregas com base nos critérios de aceitação e feedback de usuários, garantindo que os produtos estejam prontos para o lançamento.
  • Monitorar o desempenho do produto pós-lançamento, coletando feedback de usuários e analisando métricas para guiar melhorias contínuas.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrentes, identificando oportunidades para inovação e crescimento.
  • Ser a ponte entre o time de desenvolvimento e os stakeholders, garantindo comunicação clara e transparente sobre o progresso do produto e suas métricas.

A Newton Paiva contrata Coordenador de Curso de Fisioterapia para executar atividades relativas à coordenação do curso, atender aos alunos e professores, acompanhar os processos de captação e retenção de alunos, atuar nos órgãos colegiados do curso, acompanhar os indicadores de qualidade do curso (internos e externos), captação de convênios e parcerias.

Os seus principais desafios como Coordenador de Curso são:

  • Ajudar os nossos alunos em suas metas, por meio de uma boa relação, fazendo-os perceber que devem procurá-lo sempre que for preciso para resolver problemas referentes ao seu dia a dia na faculdade, como escolha de disciplinas, problemas ou queixas com os docentes, ou demais pedidos e demandas que venham a surgir, colaborando para que nossos alunos possam atingir seus objetivos educacionais e de carreira, contribuindo, dessa forma, para a solidificação da nossa marca.
  • Trabalhar em equipe com os professores, com empenho e foco, visando a uma contínua melhora no processo de ensino, proporcionando aos professores toda a orientação necessária para que possam cumprir as metas e os prazos acadêmicos, estimulando-os a participar dos programas de capacitação da instituição, contribuindo, dessa forma, para a melhoria constante da qualidade acadêmica.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos dos processos acadêmicos, como lançamento de oferta de disciplinas no portal, atividades dos programas de experiências, entrega de documentação do estágio e trabalho de conclusão de curso. Deve, também, supervisionar as atividades de pesquisa, se existirem, assim como as atividades de nivelamento.
  • Trabalhar em equipe com os órgãos de assessoramento para elaborar ou atualizar o Projeto Pedagógico do Curso, construindo um projeto de qualidade, para garantir aos nossos alunos a melhor qualidade de ensino.
  • Receber as comissões do MEC para o processo de autorização, reconhecimento e renovações, buscando conquistar as melhores médias nesses processos. Será, também, o responsável por fornecer informações para preenchimento dos formulários de avaliação do MEC e do Censo Escolar do INEP.
  • Liderar o fechamento de novas parcerias corporativas, participar das reuniões comerciais, coordenar atividades de orientação sobre cursos e coordenadores, além de participar de feiras de profissões.
  • Realizar palestras promocionais, interagir com conselhos regionais/nacionais dos cursos e compartilhar com a equipe de vendas das instituições Wyden sobre os atributos dos cursos oferecidos.

Buscamos um profissional com:

  • Mandatório Bacharelado em Fisioterapia;
  • Titulação: Mestrado ou Doutorado;
  • Desejável experiência como coordenador de curso ou no mercado em cargo de gestão;
  • Desejável conhecimento ou interesse em metodologias ativas;
  • Capacidade de comunicação expositiva e precisa do tema;
  • Atualização e domínio de conhecimentos teóricos e práticos referentes ao tema;
  • É indispensável que o candidato tenha currículo Lattes atualizado, este é um dos critérios de eliminação.

Conhecimentos Específicos Desejáveis :

  • Conhecimento nas diretrizes Curriculares Nacional do curso;
  • Conhecimento da legislação educacional;
  • Conhecimento do estatuto que regulamenta a profissão;
  • Conhecimento em ENADE;
  • Conhecimento em orçamento;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ativas;
  • Conhecimento em Projetos pedagógicos;
  • Experiência como docente no ensino superior;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas.

Informações adicionais

Carga horária semanal de 20 horas

Etapas do processo

  • Etapa 5: Contratação

Junte-se ao nosso time!

Há 50 anos transformando a vida de diversas famílias, a Newton está entre as principais instituições de Ensino Superior de Minas Gerais. O Centro Universitário alia a tradição à sua capacidade de inovação constante, desde o início da década de 1970.

Durante este meio século, a Newton cresceu, evoluiu e se modificou junto com Belo Horizonte. Hoje possui dois campi na Capital Mineira, equipados com o que há de mais avançado em laboratórios, núcleos de pesquisa, equipamentos e bibliotecas.

Além da reconhecida qualidade de ensino e de privilegiar a prática, a Newton investe permanentemente no relacionamento com o mercado, firmando importantes parcerias para proporcionar as melhores perspectivas e oportunidades profissionais.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Fisioterapeutas Visitadores , apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Fisioterapia e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fisioterapia (CREFITO).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo o seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados a mobilidade humana. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequados e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  • Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  • Garantir a continuidade da Assistência em Fisioterapia, por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.
  • Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido.

Company Overview
A well-established international mining company operating across several continents, including South America.

Job Summary
This role is the primary point of accountability for ensuring the smooth and compliant operation of the Shared Services Center (SSC) across the LATAM region.   4. Risk and Escalation Management
    • Address escalated compliance or operational issues from SSC vendors promptly.
    • Implement formal escalation processes with clear communication to regional and site-level stakeholders.

  5. Continuous Improvement
    • Drive initiatives to improve SSC efficiency, incorporating automation and feedback.
    • Champion process enhancements tailored to regional needs.
    • Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and service excellence.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

Governance & Compliance

  • Strong knowledge of corporate governance, ethical standards, and industry best practices.

Other Competencies

  • Experience working in global or matrixed organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Culturally agile with the ability to collaborate across diverse teams.

description:
Data Science Research, Search AI (English, Portuguese)

Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field or related equivalent experience.
  • 3 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a PhD degree.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a PhD degree.
  • 4 years of work experience analyzing data and creating reports with statistical, quantitative modeling, and forecasting.
  • 3 years of experience in an applied research setting.
  • Experience with Python, R, or other scripting languages.
  • Experience in survey research.
  • Knowledge of statistics and a statistical software package (e.g., R, SPSS, Stata, SAS).

About the Job

At Google, data drives all of our decision-making. Quantitative Analysts work all across the organization to help shape Google's business and technical strategies by processing, analyzing and interpreting huge data sets. Using analytical excellence and statistical methods, you mine through data to identify opportunities for Google and our clients to operate more efficiently, from enhancing advertising efficacy to network infrastructure optimization to studying user behavior. As an analyst, you do more than just crunch the numbers. You work with Engineers, Product Managers, Sales Associates and Marketing teams to adjust Google's practices according to your findings. Identifying the problem is only half the job; you also figure out the solution.

The mission of Search AI Overview Data Science team is to leverage data, measurement methodologies, analysis insights and modeling to help improve Search experience in the context of latest GenAI capabilities and unlock new ways/use cases on how billions of users interact with Google search.

In Google Search, we are re-imagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you will have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders in cross-projects and team settings to identify and clarify business or product questions to answer. Provide feedback to translate and refine business questions into tractable analysis, evaluation metrics, or mathematical models.
  • Use custom data infrastructure or existing data models as appropriate, using specialized knowledge. Design and evaluate models to solve defined problems with limited precedent.
  • Gather information, business goals, priorities, and organizational context around the questions to answer, as well as the existing and upcoming data infrastructure.
  • Own the process of gathering, extracting, and compiling data across sources via relevant tools (e.g., SQL, R, Python). Format, re-structure, or validate data to ensure quality, and review the dataset to ensure it is ready for analysis.

Job description

Baruel contrata Analista de Planejamento e Controle da Manutenção (PCM) - FOCO NO ALMOXARIFADO (Também para PCD) , para atuar em Osasco – SP.

A Baruel Van trabalha para garantir conforto e segurança para os nossos clientes, com uma frota com mais de 150 veículos desde Ônibus, Micro Ônibus, Vans e Carros Executivos.

Nos tornamos referência na Grande São Paulo com excelência, competência e ética.

Venha conhecer e fazer parte:


Main responsibilities

Planejamento da Manutenção :

  • Elaboração de planos de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva.
  • Planejamento de intervenções de manutenção com base em especificações dos equipamentos e de acordo com as necessidades da produção.
  • Definição de cronogramas de manutenção e alocação de recursos necessários (equipes, materiais e equipamentos).

Controle de Atividades :

  • Acompanhamento da execução das atividades de manutenção, garantindo que os prazos e os custos sejam respeitados.
  • Emissão de relatórios sobre o andamento da manutenção e indicadores de performance (KPIs), como tempo de inatividade e custo por manutenção.
  • Controle de estoque de peças e materiais para manutenção.

Gestão de Recursos :

  • Acompanhamento e controle dos recursos necessários para a execução das manutenções (equipamentos, ferramentas, materiais e pessoal).
  • Garantir a segurança do trabalho, conforme as normas internas e as regulamentações.

Análise de Desempenho :

  • Análise de falhas e desempenho de equipamentos e máquinas.
  • Implementação de melhorias baseadas na análise de dados coletados de manutenções anteriores.

Elaboração de Procedimentos :

  • Criação e atualização de procedimentos operacionais para as equipes de manutenção.
  • Desenvolvimento de documentos técnicos, instruções de trabalho e normas internas de operação.

Integração com Outras Áreas :

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de produção, logística e segurança para garantir que as manutenções ocorram sem impactar significativamente a operação.

Gestão de Indicadores e Custos :

  • Acompanhamento de orçamentos e custos das manutenções.
  • Análise de relatórios para a identificação de oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência.

Controle de estoque : Garantir o recebimento, armazenamento, organização e controle dos materiais e produtos no almoxarifado.

Conferência de notas fiscais : Receber, conferir e armazenar os materiais com base nas notas fiscais e ordens de compra.

Inventário : Realizar inventários periódicos, registrando as quantidades de materiais e produtos em estoque, garantindo a precisão dos registros.

Distribuição de materiais : Requisitar, separar e entregar materiais e produtos aos departamentos ou setores que solicitarem, conforme as necessidades da empresa.

Controle de validade : Verificar a validade dos materiais e produtos, quando aplicável, e garantir que itens vencidos sejam descartados ou utilizados antes do prazo.

Gestão de pedidos : Monitorar o estoque para antecipar as necessidades de reposição, evitando faltas de materiais essenciais e otimizando os custos.

Segurança no almoxarifado : Seguir normas de segurança no armazenamento e manuseio de produtos, especialmente em relação a materiais perigosos ou inflamáveis, garantindo a integridade dos colaboradores.

Controle de devoluções : Receber e controlar materiais devolvidos, registrando a origem da devolução e o destino adequado.

Atribuições no Almoxarifado

  • Organizar os materiais de acordo com categorias ou critérios estabelecidos, como tipo de produto, data de recebimento ou frequência de uso.
  • Acompanhar a entrada e saída de produtos e materiais do almoxarifado, atualizando os registros em sistema.
  • Realizar o controle físico e informatizado do estoque, incluindo a realização de inventários periódicos.
  • Responsabilizar-se pela armazenagem correta dos produtos, com base nas normas de segurança e integridade dos mesmos.
  • Zelar pela manutenção do ambiente de trabalho, garantindo que o almoxarifado esteja em condições adequadas para o armazenamento dos materiais.
  • Colaborar com outros departamentos, como compras, para garantir o abastecimento de materiais necessários para a operação.
  • Receber e inspecionar os produtos entregues pelos fornecedores, verificando a qualidade e a quantidade conforme as ordens de compra.
  • Ajudar na organização de áreas externas de estoque, como o pátio de carga e descarga, caso aplicável.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação : Ensino Médio completo (preferencialmente com cursos complementares em áreas relacionadas, como logística, administração ou gestão de estoques).
  • Experiência : Experiência prévia na função de almoxarife ou em áreas relacionadas, como controle de estoque ou logística (preferencialmente em empresas do mesmo ramo).
  • Conhecimentos técnicos :
  • Noções de controle de estoque e inventário.
  • Conhecimento básico de informática, incluindo o uso de planilhas e sistemas de gestão de estoque (ERP).
  • Familiaridade com normas de segurança no armazenamento de materiais, especialmente para itens químicos, inflamáveis ou pesados.
  • Habilidades e competências :
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas.
  • Facilidade em realizar tarefas repetitivas e controle rigoroso de inventário.
  • Aptidão física : Capacidade para realizar atividades físicas, como movimentação de materiais, quando necessário.
  • Disponibilidade : Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, se necessário, para dar suporte em atividades fora do horário comercial.

Additional information

DESEJÁVEIS

  • Conhecimento/Saber lidar com pessoas;
  • Capacidade analítica e visão de melhoria contínua.
  • Experiência em empresas de transporte ou manutenção de veículos.
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de manutenção e controle de custos.

title: Desenvolvimento de software processo seletivo continuo
description:
PROCESSO SELETIVO CONTÍNUO

A dti está em constante crescimento e por isso alguns papeis possuem uma demanda contínua de novos profissionais, de diferentes perfis técnicos e senioridade. Ao invés de publicarmos dezenas de vagas para essas posições, trabalhamos com uma vaga central, a Vaga mãe, onde você, ao se inscrever, estará disponível para receber convites para todos os contextos com vagas abertas na empresa. Essa é a fonte primária de busca por pessoas candidatas de nossas Tech Recruiters.

PROCURAMOS UMA PESSOA QUE:

  • Seja apaixonada por promover inovações e por desenvolver;
  • Tenha um bom pensamento lógico e muita vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a dti digital;
  • Seja focada e proativa;
  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e se comunique bem;
  • Seja criativa: capaz de tomar decisões de maneira autônoma e de se comunicar com clientes traduzindo suas necessidades e problemas ao longo da implementação das novas estratégias digitais de interação, proporcionando uma experiência incrível com a tecnologia;
  • E que se identifique com a nossa cultura!

REQUISITOS BÁSICOS:

  • Formação em Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia de Sistemas, Engenharia Elétrica, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou equivalentes.

REQUISITOS QUE NÃO SÃO OBRIGATÓRIOS, MAS QUE FARÃO VOCÊ SE DESTACAR:

  • Conhecimento em C#;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Java / .Net;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Front End - HTML, JS, CSS.

BENEFÍCIOS DE TRABALHAR COM A DTI:

  • Previdência Privada (Para cada real depositado pelo colaborador, limitado a 6% do salário, a dti complementa com o mesmo valor);
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale alimentação (R$890/mês);
  • Plano de Saúde sem desconto para o colaborador e dependentes;
  • Auxílio home office de R$120,00;
  • Parceria com SESC para desconto em acomodações e atividades de lazer;
  • Desconto em cursos de inglês com a Open English e eHeadset;
  • Reembolso de certificação;
  • Parceria com a PUC Minas: Disponibilizado aos crafters e aos seus dependentes (cônjuges e filhos) bolsa de 20% de desconto sobre as parcelas de graduação que são os cursos elegíveis e bolsa de 15% de desconto sobre as parcelas de pós-graduação latu senso (especialização e MBA), oferecidos pelo IEC e pela PUC Minas Virtual;
  • Desconto MBA USP/ESALQ: cursos Essential e MBA (pós-graduação lato sensu) distância e presencial;
  • Parceria com a PUC-RS: 10% de desconto em Cursos de Graduação online, MBA e Especialização (online e presencial), Idiomas e Certificações;
  • Parceria com FIAP: é disponibilizado aos crafters e aos seus dependentes (cônjuges e filhos) bolsa de 10% de desconto sobre as parcelas de graduação e colégio (FIAP School e Módulo) e 20% no valor das mensalidades dos cursos de MBA, Pós Tech ou SHIFT, nos formatos presencial e on-line;
  • Descontos em Farmácias-Drogasil e Droga Raia;
  • Ambiente descontraído, flexível e com feedbacks constantes;
  • Rotina com aprendizado constante, com Tech Shots, Rodas de Conversa e Knowledge Transfers.

TRAJETÓRIA NA DTI

Na dti, o Plano de Carreira Ágil é uma jornada de crescimento contínuo, onde cada crafter tem a liberdade de traçar seu caminho, com o apoio de ferramentas e programas desenhados para inspirar e alinhar o desenvolvimento pessoal aos seus sonhos. O Trajetórias é a bússola que orienta esse percurso, sempre valorizando a autonomia e impulsionando conquistas extraordinárias.

IMPORTANTE! MODELO DE TRABALHO
Para algumas vagas, atuamos com um tipo de modelo de trabalho chamado híbrido, que consiste em unir o melhor do trabalho remoto e do presencial. Dessa forma, em algumas vagas é importante que nosso futuro crafter tenha a disponibilidade e a possibilidade de ir presencialmente até a sede da empresa, na cidade de Belo Horizonte, para reuniões, ritos, eventos etc, quando for necessário.

E aí, se identificou com a nossa cultura? Então corre para se inscrever.

Se o seu currículo for selecionado para a primeira fase do nosso processo seletivo, entraremos em contato, então fique atenta(o) ao seu e-mail (inclusive na pasta do spam) e telefone, ok? Caso seu currículo não seja triado, não enviamos feedback, mas você ficará no nosso banco de currículos e poderá se candidatar novamente em outro momento ;)

We're revolutionizing the fitness & wellness industry, and we’re looking for talented people to help us do it. Mindbody + ClassPass bring together the best of both sides of the market: Mindbody is the industry’s most trusted all-in-one technology platform; ClassPass is one of the most popular apps for fitness & self-care enthusiasts. Together we’re partnering with more than 70,000 fitness studios, gyms, salons, and spas around the world. We’re not just another tech company—we’re far and away the leader of our industry. So join the team, work with mission-led people, and enjoy amazing benefits. Let’s see what we can accomplish together!
Who we are
We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!
Your role
As a Software Engineer II, you’ll be a part of a team working to build secure systems for the Mindbody ecosystem. You’ll pursue continuous improvement to help Mindbody achieve its mission: Powering the world’s fitness and wellness businesses and connecting them with more consumers, more effectively, than anyone else.
You'll likely spend time working on

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and QA to iterate on the design, implementation and deployment of our product.
  • Build and maintain backend systems and applications, tightly scoped work with supervision and support.
  • Navigating code reviews thoughtfully and constructively contributing to conversations around pull requests.
  • Participating in retrospectives as a constructive team member.
  • Seek different perspectives and solicit honest feedback.
  • Practice engineering best practices (e.g., automated testing, code reviews, proper monitoring).
  • Learning one or more technical areas and becoming increasingly comfortable contributing to your team’s codebase.
  • Take delight in delighting our users.
  • Care about our studio partners and want to help them grow their business
About the right team member
You know the best platform is created through collaboration and iteration and you’re looking for the right opportunity, and the right team, to expand your experience. You seek feedback because it can turn good work into great work. You are naturally curious and enjoy learning from those around you. You're not afraid to ask questions early and often when navigating new code or systems. You take initiative to solve clearly defined problems, and you welcome constructive feedback as part of your growth. You strive to contribute positively to your team’s culture and take pride in doing thoughtful work.
At Mindbody+ClassPass we value people who are intellectually curious, who are pragmatic not dogmatic, and people who care about our product, their teammates, and their own personal growth. We are faced with an interesting set of technical challenges, and we believe in giving our engineers the autonomy to go and solve them. Much of our team comes from non-traditional computing backgrounds; we know that by bringing together a diverse set of voices we’ll be able to build a better product, and a better company. We care less about what languages or frameworks you know, and care more that you are excited to produce high-quality code and be constantly learning. Our engineers work in cross-functional teams that are focused on impact, and movement between teams is encouraged. We work very closely with our brilliant product team to deliver a world class user experience, and ultimately to empower our users to live their fullest, healthiest lives.
You'll thrive in this role with experience in
  • 2-4 years experience in programming large-scale SaaS products.
  • Experience building backend services with an object-oriented language such as C# or Java.
  • Experience designing and architecting backend services.
  • Experience Designing and working with Microservice architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring systems such as New Relic or Kibana.
  • Familiarity with SDLC and programming design patterns, and Agile methodology.
  • Experience reviewing new feature impact on an application and recognizing potential risks.
  • Detail-oriented, professional and possesses a positive work attitude.
  • Ability to communicate professionally both verbally and in writing.
Technologies you'll be working with
  • Experience building highly performant and high-quality backends. We use Kotlin, Python, C#, React and Ruby in our stack but we're most interested in your experience building great systems.
  • Understanding of SQL and relational databases.
Have we piqued your curiosity?
Sound like the role for you? We’d love to hear from you! Even if you’re not 100% sure about potential fit, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for the right person, not the perfect series of checkboxes.

title: Power System Engineer
description:
Landis+Gyr is a leading global provider of integrated energy management solutions. We measure and analyze energy utilization to generate empowering analytics for smart grid and infrastructure management, enabling utilities and consumers to reduce energy consumption. Our innovative and proven portfolio of software, services and intelligent sensor technology is a key driver to decarbonize the grid and helped to avoid around 9 million tons of CO2 in FY 2023. With sales of USD 2.0 billion in FY 2023, Landis+Gyr employs around 6,900 talented people across five continents .

For more than a century, we've been pioneers in energy innovation, and we continue to lead the way toward a more sustainable and efficient energy landscape.

Join us at Landis+Gyr, where we manage energy better!

About the Role
We are looking for a Power System Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of a cloud-based utility analytics product with embedded power system functionalities. This role offers the opportunity to be involved throughout the entire product lifecycle — from design and implementation to testing and customer support. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to transform market and customer needs into robust software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical guidance to the analytics product development team regarding use cases that require power system functionalities such as power flow, optimal power flow, short circuits, transients, stability, arc flash, harmonics, and grounding.

  • Collaborate with Product Owners to write clear and comprehensive product specifications for design and software teams.

  • Work closely with technical leads to ensure adherence to product-related system design guidelines.

  • Leverage deep technical knowledge to propose innovative solutions addressing steady-state and dynamic behaviors of power distribution systems.

  • Participate in pre-sales activities, supporting the technical validation of proposed solutions.

  • Act as a subject matter expert in discussions with clients and partners, addressing queries related to power system analysis within our analytics offering.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Power Engineering. Focus on power distribution, transmission modeling, and analysis (e.g., state estimation, power flow, short circuit analysis, optimization, energy markets) is highly valued.

  • Experience (2+ years preferred) in electric power engineering, including power system modeling, grid simulations, and operations.

  • Familiarity with tools for power system studies such as PowerFactory, PSS/E, or equivalent (dynamic and EMT simulation) is a plus.

  • Experience with software development and scripting (Python preferred) is a strong advantage.

  • Proven ability to analyze complex technical requirements and translate them into software functionalities.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary team environment.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Passion for problem-solving and working in an open, supportive team culture.

We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. #EnergizeYourCareer and join us on our journey towards a greener tomorrow.

title: Human Resources Director Brazil
description:
At Diaverum , we are looking for a business-oriented and hands-on HR Director to lead our HR function in Brazil. This role is critical in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and compliant work environment.

Everyone deserves a fulfilling life. That’s why we’re dedicated to enhancing the lives of renal patients.

As a global leader and the largest independent renal service provider in Europe, we have 13,000 healthcare professionals caring for around 41,000 patients across 450 clinics in 24 countries globally . We provide renal care personalized to patients’ needs and choices, offering a portfolio of treatments ranging from preventive care, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and home care, to the coordination of patients’ comorbidities and holiday dialysis.

Our vision is to transform renal care, delivering and broadening access to the highest quality of kidney care for patients around the world . At the heart of what we do is our standardized care delivery model, continuously evolving digital & AI infrastructure and people caring for patients with competence, passion and inspiration.

Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is part of the M42 group of companies , a first-of-its-kind integrated health powerhouse committed to the sustainable future of health.

Diaverum Brazil ranks first in the number of patients within the Diaverum group and is the second-largest player in the Brazilian market. The company provides renal services through its own clinics and as a third-party provider for hospitals, treating 4,500 chronic patients across 12 clinics, performing 75,000 treatments per month. Headquartered in São Paulo, its clinics are located in the São Paulo metropolitan region and the state of Sergipe, while also serving hospitals in São Paulo, Sergipe, Bahia, and João Pessoa. Diaverum Brazil has a team of 1,200 direct employees and 200 contracted nephrologists. The HR team consists of 16 members, with two based at the headquarters and the rest distributed across the clinics. With an average business growth of over 30% per year, the company is currently developing and deploying HR IT systems in a dynamic, flexible, and multidisciplinary environment.

As a key member of the Management Team , you will play a pivotal role in driving the HR strategy, talent development, employee relations, and compliance with local labour laws , ensuring alignment with global HR standards and company goals.

Reporting to the Country Manager Brazil, this role is based in São Paulo (headquarters in the Vila Olímpia neighborhood) and requires between 20% and 40% local travel.

  • Develop and implement a business-driven HR strategy , supporting the organizational structure with leadership.
  • Act as an ambassador and change agent , ensuring that Diaverum’s culture and values are a living reality.
  • Represent HR in the Country Management Team and Brazil in the global HR team , contributing to continuous improvement projects.
  • Be a visible and hands-on partner for senior leaders, managers, and employees.
  • Ensure labour law compliance and provide guidance on employment matters.
  • Equip clinic managers with HR tools to become strong “people managers.”
  • Support in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and development .
  • Oversee payroll, contracts, and HR administration .
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle , including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and performance reviews.
  • Support M&A activities , ensuring a seamless HR operational transition .
  • Lead workforce planning , ensuring talent attraction and retention.
  • Contribute to budget planning and labour efficiency initiatives with Finance and Operations.
  • Measure and report on key HR data to drive decision-making.
  • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures aligned with corporate standards.
  • Ensure HR tools are available and used effectively across the business.
  • Educate managers and employees on HR processes, including creating employee handbooks and onboarding materials.

People & Organizational Development

  • Lead organizational design initiatives with the management team.
  • Drive learning & development, ensuring training programs support business needs.
  • Oversee employee onboarding, ensuring a strong integration into Diaverum’s culture and values.
  • Lead succession planning for key management roles and specialists.
  • Implement the annual performance appraisal process, ensuring clear goal setting and development plans.
  • Support restructuring initiatives to optimize the organization’s effectiveness.
  • Oversee payroll and benefits administration , ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Implement a structured annual compensation review process based on market benchmarks and performance.
  • Develop compensation strategies that drive a high-performance culture .

ABOUT YOU

You have 8-10 years of experience in HR across multiple disciplines and a proven track record in leading change within multilevel organizations . Your strong business acumen allows you to align HR strategies with company goals, and you have an in-depth understanding of Brazilian labour law . You have worked in an international environment , and if you have experience in the healthcare industry , that’s a big plus. You hold a university degree in HR, Finance, or a related field , and you are fluent in English . You are comfortable using MS Office and other HR tools to support business operations.

You are a customer-focused HR leader with strong relationship-building skills. You take a hands-on approach , ensuring HR strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed. Your communication, listening, and coaching skills allow you to support both employees and managers, creating a positive and productive work environment. As a change agent , you have the ability to lead HR transformations and integration processes, making a real impact on the business. You have a continuous improvement mindset , always striving to optimize processes and enhance the employee experience.

If you have experience in an international company and a background in the healthcare industry , that would be a plus!

If you’re ready to take on a strategic and operational HR leadership role in a fast-paced, global environment , we’d love to hear from you! Apply now or reach out for more details.

At Diaverum, we value diversity and are committed to equal opportunities. We strive to create an inclusive workplace environment for everyone, welcoming applicants regardless of ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, age, or marital status.

title: AI and Process Automation Manager
description:
Why work at Rentcars?

We are the largest car rental platform in Latin America and one of the top global players in the industry. Since 2009, we've been connecting customers to the best car rental options available.

Today, we’re present in over 160 countries! We partner with the world’s best and biggest rental companies, offering services in more than 5,000 cities and 20,000 pickup locations around the globe.

With headquarters in Curitiba (Brazil) and Amsterdam (The Netherlands), we are a global company focused on excellence and innovation! We're also Great Place to Work certified and a B-Corp company, reinforcing our commitment to sustainability, diversity, and care for our Renties — that’s what we call our team members.

Looking for a place to grow and have an incredible career journey, with benefits that adapt to your lifestyle? Check out this opportunity and follow the selection process!

AI and Process Automation Manager

In this role, you will be responsible for:

Leading the company’s digital transformation through the strategic implementation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, focused on scalability, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement of the customer experience.

AI Strategy & Digital Transformation

  • Develop and implement a strategic AI roadmap aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Create an implementation framework that integrates process design, data analysis, and technology solutions.
  • Define clear, measurable KPIs to track the impact of initiatives across departments.

Process Optimization & Automation

  • Identify and prioritize intelligent automation opportunities across departments (HR, Marketing, Sales, Product, Operations, and Finance).
  • Develop AI-driven solutions to reduce operational costs, increase efficiency, and eliminate bottlenecks.
  • Implement predictive analytics methodologies to support data-driven strategic decisions.

Customer Service Transformation

  • Lead the strategy for self-service and smart support, focusing on next-generation chatbots and virtual assistants, personalized customer experiences, and response time reduction.
  • Design intelligent support flows that balance automation and human interaction.
  • Improve customer satisfaction metrics such as NPS and CSAT through automated solutions.

Organizational Enablement & Engagement

  • Design AI training programs for all organizational levels.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning in emerging technologies.
  • Promote workshops, hackathons, and other initiatives to encourage AI adoption.

Partnerships & Innovation Management

  • Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with universities, startups, and tech companies.
  • Monitor AI trends and innovations, recommending new tools and solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to gain competitive advantage through emerging technologies.

Governance & Communication

  • Ensure ethical and responsible use of AI, respecting governance and transparency principles.
  • Act as an internal and external spokesperson for digital transformation.
  • Produce executive reports on AI initiative outcomes and strategic recommendations.

What we expect from you (experience, soft and hard skills):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or related fields.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Participation in digital transformation projects.
  • Proven experience implementing AI solutions in corporate environments.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced knowledge of Artificial Intelligence.
  • Familiarity with machine learning, LLMs, and generative tools.
  • Strong skills in data analysis and process design.
  • Excellent communication and ability to translate technical concepts for diverse audiences.
  • Strategic thinking, analytical mindset, and results-oriented approach.
  • Strong leadership in driving organizational change focused on innovation.
  • Must be available to work on-site in Curitiba, PR.

Success Indicators

Operational Efficiency

  • Reduction in operational costs.
  • Number of processes automated.
  • Average time to implement AI solutions.

Customer Experience

  • Increase in NPS (Net Promoter Score).
  • Reduction in average response time.
  • Improvement in satisfaction scores (CSAT).

Organizational Transformation

  • Number of employees trained in AI.
  • Participation in innovation initiatives.
  • Implemented projects with measurable results.

Innovation & Competitiveness

  • Strategic partnerships established.
  • External recognition in tech innovation.
  • Implementation of pioneering solutions.

This position plays a strategic and cross-functional role within the organization, requiring a holistic approach that integrates technology, business, and people—driving a true culture of data-driven innovation.

We know you need your freedom to make your own choices, which is why our benefits program is flexible! We call it “Beneflex”, and it works like this: you have some basic benefits, at no cost, and points to distribute among the options that suit you best!

Basic benefits:

  • (no cost) Unimed health plan with no monthly fees for holder and dependents, only coparticipation (regional);
  • (no cost) Life insurance;
  • (no cost) Meal voucher or food voucher (R$34,87 per day worked), without discounts, with the possibility of upgrade;

Expand your possibilities with:

Other benefits, for all Renties:

  • Learning Rocks, a platform focused on soft skills;
  • Udemy, a teaching platform for hard skills;
  • Annual bonus linked to goals, management by objectives (MBO);
  • Birthday day off;

  • Maternity kit for pregnant women, extended maternity leave (6 months) and a R$800 aid in the month that the baby is born;
  • Keiken, health and wellness app, with psychological assistance;

For those at the Curitiba’s headquarters:

  • Fresh fruit every day;

title: Marketing & Prime Finance Manager, BR Marketing and Prime Finance
description:
Marketing & Prime Finance Manager, BR Marketing and Prime Finance

We are looking for a Finance Manager to play a critical role in Brazil, as a finance partner for the Prime & Marketing team. The role will support multiple senior marketing business leaders, with broad scope and autonomy. This strategic role will drive financial planning, analysis, and decision-making for Amazon's marketing investments and Prime business in Brazil. The right individual will have exceptional finance skills, strong understanding of Finance & Accounting principles, solid analytical skills, firm business judgment capable of driving an organization to the right results, and an ability to influence and earn trust with senior leaders.

Key job responsibilities

  1. Create, improve, and maintain financial metrics, reports and scorecards used for consolidation reports. Measure marketing programs on P&L in a short and long term.
  2. Establish guardrails in Marketing and Prime's team willingness to invest in acquiring or retaining customers.
  3. Develop relationships with business teams, implement new processes and drive continuous improvement.
  4. Annual Plans, Forecasts, Month End Close and Variance Analysis.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience.
  • 6+ years of multiple finance and accounting roles experience.
  • 6+ years of Accounts Receivable or Account Payable experience.
  • 6+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience.
  • 6+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience.
  • 6+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience.
  • 6+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience.
  • Advanced English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience.
  • MBA, or CPA.
  • Knowledge of SQL/ETL.
  • Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards).
  • Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results.

  • Trabalhar com leveza e equilíbrio, valorizando o próprio bem-estar e, claro, o das outras pessoas.

  • Licenças maternidade e paternidade estendidas, válidas também para casos de adoção e guarda judicial. Durante esse período, a pessoa continua recebendo o VA / VR.

Outras vantagens que tornam a Dito um lugar especial️:

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Product Development and Operations / Full time / Hybrid

Guidewire’s Cloud Engineering Team, part of Guidewire Global Support (GGS), provides 24/7 support for customers using Guidewire’s software on the Guidewire Cloud Platform. The team focuses on automating processes to enhance system efficiency and reliability.

Cloud Engineers play a key role in operating Guidewire’s cloud platform and Insurance Suite products, developing tools to optimize system availability and performance for multi-tenant SaaS environments. They work closely with product developers to ensure the platform meets functional and non-functional requirements like performance, observability, and maintainability.

The role requires strong independence, problem-solving skills, and expertise in technologies like Kubernetes and Aurora. Ideal candidates are passionate about automation, eager to learn new tools, and experienced in SaaS production support within cloud-native AWS environments.

Job Description

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Deploy and operate shared multi-tenant infrastructure for a SaaS microservice-based containerized systems in addition to customer-centric application environments.
  2. Administer and automate the team’s growing presence in AWS Operational support for Guidewire’s flagship highly integrated Java-based Insurance Suite web applications.
  3. Implement and operate a complex single sign-on SAML/OAuth-based central authentication platform.
  4. Develop and deploy tooling to aid in driving 24x7x365 service operations of critical worldwide systems.
  5. Automate deployment tasks for core product and infrastructure tools and maintain automation infrastructure.
  6. Create system documentation and training materials to empower and educate our own and others.

Required Education, Skills and Experience

  1. Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field.
  2. Cloud computing experience - AWS preferred.
  3. Familiarity with the Agile software development lifecycle.
  4. Background with Linux systems administration and strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, Go, etc.
  5. Experience supporting web applications running on Java / Apache / Tomcat in a live production environment.
  6. Demonstrable experience with automating systems and infrastructure with Terraform.
  7. Production-At-Scale support background in a heavily microservice-based world.
  8. Working with Kubernetes is a plus.
  9. Strong understanding of Single-Sign On, SAML, oAuth (Bonus points if hands-on experience with Okta).
  10. Background utilizing and supporting log analytical tools such as DataDog (Logging and APM). Great understanding of DevOps tools, CI/CD and hands-on experience with git, Bitbucket and TeamCity.
  11. Seasoned expertise around x.509 certificate technology and basic concepts of encryption.
  12. Solid understanding of concepts surrounding containerized networking and all things IP.
  13. Experience working with Relational Databases such as Aurora Postgres and/or Oracle RDS.
  14. Advanced exposure to broad technical skills such as application development, web UI (design and development), JSON, application architecture.
  15. Ability to read and interpret application server thread dumps, Catalina outputs, CloudTrail, and other critical logging outputs.

Personal Qualities and Soft skills

  1. A no-fear approach to ambiguity and a startup-like culture.
  2. You greatly prefer CLIops to ClickOps.
  3. You enjoy teaching and being a mentor to others.
  4. Outstanding troubleshooting skills; ability to think critically and display an aptitude for problem-solving.
  5. Strongly analytical mind with a penchant for process development and enhancement.
  6. Display a strong work ethic and do whatever it takes to get the job done.
  7. A highly positive can-do attitude with a knack for being a team player.
  8. Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts to a varied audience.
  9. Demonstrate strong follow-through and consistently keep commitments to customers and employees.

Other Requirements

  1. Ability to read, write, and speak fluent English.
  2. We provide 24x7 support to our customers, so we expect you to take turns with your teammates being on-call for weekend production emergencies or to provide rotating weekend operational support.
  3. Travel – Expect occasional travel (less than 5%) to other Guidewire offices for training and team meetings.

Work Timings / Shifts : (Rotational Weekend on-call)

Candidates are required to be on rotational weekend on-call.

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. description:
Job Purpose

Responsible for the management and maintenance of the network systems and associated equipment. Works with Network and Systems Administrator to troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues. Maintains technical expertise in all areas of network and computer hardware and software interconnection and interfacing, such as routers, multiplexers, firewalls, gateways, etc.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage tasking as directed by IT management to ensure timely implementation or delivery of critical USAP infrastructure.
  • Install, configure, maintain and document network hardware and software suites at multiple sites. Isolate faults and diagnose system failures to resolve problems in a timely manner.
  • Monitor network performance and reliability to proactively identify potential problems.
  • Establish and maintain secure networking environments based on security standards in conjunction with USAP policies.
  • Provide engineering support to IT for new deployment, enhancements, or modifications to IT systems, both on-ice and off-ice.
  • Coordinate any modifications to the USAP network environment with other IT departments and affected users.
  • Assist with life-cycle management evaluations and recommendations.
  • Provide verbal, written and diagrammed inputs as requested by IT Management.
  • Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace program and ensuring safety is the highest priority in the work place.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship or permanent residence is required.
  • Degree in Engineering or Computer Science or related field with emphasis in computer networking preferred.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or higher Cisco certification is required.
  • 5+ years of experience accepted in lieu of certification.
  • CCNA plus additional technical networking vendor certifications preferred.
  • Five years of directly relevant experience in network engineering is required, including:
  • Expertise in primary network topologies, LANs/WANs (Ethernet, variants), TCP/IP protocol (IPv4) and standards including ICMP, SNMP and Syslog required.
  • Experience with configuring routing protocols, such as EIGRP is required.
  • Configuration management expertise with Cisco IOS and hardware. Prior experience installing, configuring and maintaining Cisco routers and switches is required.
  • Experience with the configuration and management of network firewalls is required.
  • Experience with VoIP infrastructure, implementation, and configuration is required.
  • Experience with Virtual Private Networks and the various protocols and implementations is required.
  • Ability to perform fault isolation and resolution in a methodical, thorough manner is required.
  • Understanding of and experience applying Information Security concepts to core network infrastructure and data transport is required.

Competencies

  • Communication Proficiency.
  • Organizational Skills.
  • Problem Solving/Analysis.
  • Teamwork Orientation.
  • Technical Capacity.
  • Time Management.

Physical Requirements

  • Deployment will be required in this position. In addition to the completion of a compatibility face-to-face interview, the individual in the position must successfully complete the physical and dental examinations as required by the NSF for deploying to Antarctica. Failure to meet these requirements may result in withdrawal of employment offer or other employment action.
  • Complies with applicable safety, environment, health, and waste management policies and procedures.
  • Individual must be capable of operating a standard desktop computer; must be able to lift and carry up to 10 pounds.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Position Expectations

  • This is a full-time, seasonal position located in Antarctica.
  • All expenses paid while deployed including meals, lodging, cold-weather gear, tools, and travel to/from Antarctica.
  • Performance Period: October 2025 - November 2026.
  • Employment will require candidate obtaining a public trust clearance.

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.


With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.


Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

You will be part of an international team, driving the development of 1GLOBAL's eSIM platform, including our consumer and IoT solutions. We are looking for a talented developer and team player, capable of handling architectural and technical specifications, designing and implementing new services, maintaining existing components, and testing our applications.
The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build high impact features and contribute to the architecture design; aim towards resiliency, scalability, security and fault tolerance;
  • Advocate for high code quality, readability and high tests coverage;
  • Promote best practices for a high-scale web (or mobile) environment;
  • Work with an Agile methodology;
  • Identify areas of improvement in the codebase and promote them through seamless integrations, documenting solutions and new flows;
  • Mentor junior members when needed and contribute with meaningful reviews.
  • 4+ years of experience in Java software development;
  • Experience with unit/integration/e2e testing (test-driven development is a plus);
  • Proficiency with REST APIs, both in implementing and consuming the interfaces;
  • Experience with development tools and processes (Git-flow, peer reviewing);
  • Familiarity with relational databases, CI/CD flows, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes;
  • Good understanding of cloud services and scalable infrastructure;
  • Excellent communication skills (fluent in English, both written and spoken), with a self-motivated and autonomous mindset.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
Você é uma pessoa motivada, com vontade de crescer e construir uma carreira sólida? Busca um ambiente onde seu trabalho é valorizado e seu desenvolvimento profissional é uma prioridade? Então, temos a oportunidade perfeita para você!
Em nossa empresa, valorizamos a dedicação, o comprometimento e o desejo de fazer a diferença. Como vigilante, você não estará apenas protegendo patrimônios; estará também zelando pela segurança e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e visitantes. Sua atuação será fundamental para manter a ordem e a tranquilidade, tornando o ambiente mais seguro para todos.
Em nossa empresa oferecemos, investimos no crescimento dos nossos colaboradores com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de carreira.
Se você está pronto para assumir um papel essencial, onde seu trabalho será valorizado e terá um impacto positivo na segurança e tranquilidade de muitos, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe de vigilantes. Aqui, seu crescimento profissional é nossa prioridade.
Não perca a chance de integrar uma equipe dedicada e crescer em um ambiente que valoriza o seu potencial. Junte-se a nós e comece uma jornada de sucesso como vigilante!
Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e contar com seu talento em nossa equipe.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Garantir a segurança e a proteção do patrimônio, dos colaboradores e dos visitantes, monitorando e prevenindo atividades suspeitas ou ilegais, assegurando a ordem e o cumprimento das normas internas.

  • Realizar rondas periódicas nas instalações para prevenir e detectar sinais de intrusão, roubo, vandalismo ou outras atividades ilegais.
  • Controlar e registrar a entrada e saída de pessoas, veículos e materiais nas dependências dos clientes.
  • Controlar a entrada de visitantes e prestadores de serviços, garantindo que estejam devidamente cadastrados e acompanhados.
  • Identificar e relatar situações de risco ou condições inseguras, tomando ações preventivas para evitar acidentes ou incidentes.
  • Atuar de forma rápida e eficiente em situações de contingência, como incêndios, acidentes ou invasões, seguindo os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Colaborar com as forças de segurança pública em casos de crimes ou distúrbios.
  • Manter registros precisos de atividades diárias, incidentes, ocorrências e outras informações relevantes.
  • Preencher relatórios de ocorrência e comunicar aos superiores sobre quaisquer incidentes significativos.
  • Oferecer atendimento cordial e profissional aos colaboradores, visitantes e prestadores de serviços, fornecendo informações e orientações quando necessário.
  • Auxiliar na organização e controle de eventos internos.

O vigilante é responsável por garantir a segurança e integridade das instalações e pessoas, prevenindo ações criminosas e respondendo prontamente a contingências. Este profissional deve ser atento, proativo e capaz de atuar de forma eficaz em situações de risco.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Curso de formação de vigilante com reciclagem em dia.
  • Experiência prévia na área de segurança patrimonial ou funções similares.
  • Conhecimento básico em informática e sistemas de vigilância eletrônica.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em turnos, incluindo noites, fins de semana e feriados.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de lidar com situações de stress e tomar decisões rápidas.

Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional skills that would be nice to have
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Sede de aprendizado: Profissional que está disposto a aprender continuamente e buscar oportunidade de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional.

Sobre a Rodobens:

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Consórcio

A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais.

Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor.

Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade!

Main responsibilities

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Realizar atendimento e negociação com nossos clientes, no local para comercialização de consórcio;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais para clientes;

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Superior Cursando/Completo;
  • Habilidades: proativo; responsável; habilidade para resolver problemas, matemática básica (demonstrações financeiras / cálculos simples);

  8. Experiência com cloud Azure - Compute, Network, Storage, Security, Architecture;

É nosso compromisso, aqui na Ultragaz, estimular um ambiente de muita liberdade e igualdade, de muitas cores e sotaques. Um espaço acolhedor às diferentes vozes que alcançam todos os lugares indistintamente. Define quem somos e a diversidade em que acreditamos. Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso.
Junte-se a nós e seja parte dessa transformação. Estamos moldando juntos um futuro mais energético e limpo para todos. Quer fazer parte dessa jornada? Inscreva-se na vaga e venha somar sua energia com a gente!

Dedicamos toda a nossa energia em construir relacionamentos, oferecer mais conveniência e chegar a todos os cantos do Brasil. Usamos nossa experiência e tecnologia para juntos criarmos soluções em energia com foco nos clientes, garantindo uma melhor gestão de suas casas e seus negócios. Nosso olhar está lá na frente. Somamos ao nosso portfólio energia elétrica de origem renovável, Biometano, gás retirado do processo de decomposição de resíduos orgânicos, e o Gás Natural Comprimido, que nos dá a capacidade de atender clientes que estão distantes dos gasodutos, este movimento nos habilita a exercer papel fundamental na transição para uma matriz energética mais limpa e sustentável, pilar que suporta nosso compromisso com a sociedade. Somos uma empresa que valoriza o protagonismo, a consistência do nosso trabalho, a conexão, transformação e claro, pessoas no centro.
